item.title: Correction · 1401 Third Street: The Assessor's rolls list this parcel at 455 Mission Bay Blvd…
item.description: The Assessor's rolls list this parcel at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South through 2012 and at 1401 Third Street from 2013; no source read explains why the 2007 permit gives lot 012 instead of lot 032. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721032.

item.title: Correction · 1401 Third Street: The map notes cited a CBRE listing for a different building (1455…
item.description: The map notes cited a CBRE listing for a different building (1455 3rd St) as a source; it was removed, and the Assessor roll for parcel 8721032 is now cited for the size, year built and office use. The record's permit source said the permit completed on 2008-04-24; the permit record says 2009-11-17, so that was corrected everywhere it appeared. The claim that 455 Mission Bay Blvd South was this parcel's address before a renaming is now stated as our inference from the permit's location, and the summary says Mission Bay instead of Mission Bay South. Source: DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, parcel 8721032 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8721032); DataSF Building Permits, permit #200704279921 (https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=200704279921).

item.title: Planned · 1401 Third Street: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200704279921… (Apr 27, 2007)
item.description: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200704279921 filed to erect a 5-story office/lab building at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South (block 8721, lot 012); the Assessor's rolls list this parcel (lot 032) at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South for 2009 to 2012 and at 1401 Third Street from 2013, and the permit's mapped point is about 6 m from the Assessor point for the parcel; no source states why the permit's lot (012) differs from lot 032 (Apr 27, 2007). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DataSF / SF Office of the Assessor-Recorder.
